lines.text: David asks God not to be silent, because liars attack him without cause though he is a man of prayer.
The prayer asks that a wicked man be set over him and a judge stand at his right hand.
The prayer asks that his days be few, his children be fatherless, and his descendants be cut off.
The prayer asks that the cursing he wore like a coat soak into his bones like wine.
David will praise the LORD in the presence of many, because He stands at the right hand of the needy.
